close_reason: Implemented in commit 8d8b6c5 as part of the params-slot rollout. Extracted the args.as_object_mut().expect() hoist into a shared merge_extras helper (methods/metadata.rs:9-24) so the invariant is computed once per call, not once per extras-key. Helper is now used by all 5 Metadata/* method builders (metadata_get, metadata_set, metadata_changes, metadata_query, metadata_query_changes) — every site that flattens extras into args goes through the same hoisted-invariant path.
title: metadata_changes: hoist args.as_object_mut().expect() out of extras for-loop
